---
name: Narrative audit case
about: Propose or analyze a target narrative for audit
title: "[Narrative Audit] "
labels: narrative-audit
---

## Narrative Statement

State the target narrative in one sentence.

## Component Claims

Break the narrative into component claims.

## Source Status

Identify whether each component is primary-supported, review-supported, textbook-canonical, synthetic consensus, disciplinary habit, AI-frequency narrative, or untraced.

## Citation Debt

Estimate citation debt and explain why.

## What Would Change Your View

List evidence that would strengthen, weaken, or clarify the narrative.
